name: reclaim-your-net
description: ReclaimYourNet - report once, file everywhere, prove it happened. A TinyFish web agent for citizen grievance routing.

scripts.dev: npm run build:core && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace @reclaim/api && npm run build --workspace @reclaim/web
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace @reclaim/api && npm run build --workspace @reclaim/web
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test --workspace @reclaim/core
